t: Designed for convenient storage and carrying on the move, the lightweight extinguisher is perfect for use at home or when out and about. The compact size makes it ideal for use in the car, whilst camping, in caravans and for small fires anywhere in the home or outdoors. Safe and easy to use. No need to have separate water, foam, CO2 and powder extinguishers. Non-toxic and biodegradable. Supplied with a sturdy metal transport bracket for use in any vehicle.
b: Suitable for Class A, B, C, D, Electrical, F & Li-Ion Battery Fires
